full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic collage places a poised woman in a long dark dress within a turbulent coastal dreamscape. She sits slightly left of center, body turned toward the right and head raised, with one hand resting near her hip. Her skirt spreads broadly across the lower middle like a dark floating platform, its cloth folds occupying a large calm shape amid the surrounding disorder. Beneath and behind her, foaming waves crash over rocks along the left and lower edges. In the distance on the right, a castle-like cluster of towers rises from a dark rocky promontory. Above it, a massive curling cloud or wave arcs from the upper left across the sky, enclosing a pale circular opening in its hollow. The woman is photographed in a smooth studio-like tone, while the seascape carries rougher grain and dramatic natural texture; their joined edges have the slightly impossible scale of cut-paper montage. Small white surf accents lead from the lower foreground toward the far towers, while the dark mass of the dress anchors the middle. Light breaks from the upper left through the pale part of the arc, creating silver edges on spray and the woman's face. The right side of the architecture and the deep folds of her skirt remain in dense charcoal shadow. No legible lettering appears, and the narrative remains open despite the clear human silhouette. The overall composition combines a formal fashion pose with a storm-tossed Gothic landscape, balancing elegant stillness against immense swirling movement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影拼贴把一位仪态平静、身穿深色长裙的女子置于湍动的海岸梦境里。她坐在中央偏左，身体朝右、头部抬起，一只手靠近腰际。裙摆如深色漂浮平台般铺满下方中央，布料褶皱在周围混乱中构成一块宽阔安静形状。她下方与后方，起泡海浪沿左边及下缘撞击岩石。右侧远处，城堡般的塔楼群从深色岩岬升起。其上，一道巨大的卷云或浪形从左上跨过天空，在空心处围出浅色圆形开口。女子以平滑、近似影棚的影调呈现，海景则有更粗的颗粒与戏剧性自然肌理；两者拼合的边缘具有剪纸蒙太奇那种略不可能的尺度。小小白色浪花亮点从下前景引向远处塔楼，裙子的暗色大块稳住中央。光从左上方穿过弧形浅处，给飞沫与女子脸部镶上银亮边。建筑右侧和裙子深褶仍留在炭黑阴影里。没有可读文字，尽管人物剪影清楚，叙事仍保持开放。整体构图把正式的时尚姿势与风暴中的哥特式风景结合，以优雅静止平衡巨大的旋转运动。
style_prompt_en: The work has a monochrome photographic-collage surface with mismatched scales assembled into a convincing tonal whole. Smooth, carefully lit focal forms sit against rough grain, foamy textures, and turbulent cloudlike masses. Dense charcoal areas anchor the lower field, while silver-white breaks and a pale circular opening pull attention upward. Cut and blended edges shift between crisp silhouette and hazy atmosphere, making the join both visible and dreamlike. Dramatic upper-side light gives selected rims a glow but leaves deep interior folds almost black. The composition feels poised yet unstable, elegant in its contrast between still mass and swirling motion.
style_prompt_zh: 作品具有黑白摄影拼贴表面，把不匹配的尺度拼成影调可信的整体。平滑且精心受光的焦点形体置于粗颗粒、泡沫肌理和湍动云团前。浓炭黑稳住下部画域，银白裂光与浅色圆形开口把视线向上牵引。切割与融合边缘在清晰剪影和朦胧空气之间转换，使拼接既可见又像梦。戏剧性的上方侧光让局部边缘发亮，深处褶纹却几乎留黑。构图姿态稳定又不安，静止大块和旋转运动的对照令其优雅。
theme_en: A seated woman in a dark dress above stormy waves and a distant castle
theme_zh: 深色长裙女子坐在风暴海浪与远方城堡之上
name: Toshiko Okanoue
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
